description: This file contains a SCSS mixin implementation for responsive font sizing, based on the RFS (Responsive Font Sizes) methodology. It includes configuration variables, calculations for dynamic font sizes, media query handling, and documentation links, allowing for automated font resizing across different screen sizes in a CSS framework.

methods.name: rfs
methods.description: A SCSS mixin that applies responsive font sizing by calculating appropriate font-size values based on screen width and height, with support for different units and customization options.

methods.name: font-size
methods.description: A wrapper mixin that includes the rfs mixin to set responsive font sizes.

methods.name: responsive-font-size
methods.description: An alias for the font-size mixin, providing semantic clarity for setting responsive fonts.
